title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode8 Merry Christmas!

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: The day of the show
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line:
Gasp! Someone's outside!
Is it a burglar?

rows.Speaker:
Boy's Voice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line:
No, I'm no burglar...! I'm Santa Claus!
I'm about to fall. Can you please help me up?!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line:
S-Santa Claus?
Don't lie. Santa doesn't exist...

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: I never had Santa visit me... Not even once...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hmph. It's too cold for an outdoor performance, I'd say.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (I came by to make sure they weren't disgracing the park, but they seem to be doing okay so far. This one's singing has improved too.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (Still, they won't come close to our show.)

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line: There. All done! With this disguise, no one will suspect I'm actually Santa!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Isn't it 'Santa's apprentice'? And won't that disguise get you into more trouble? You could be mistaken for a burglar.

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line: Everything will work out, just you wait and see! Huh? Oh nooo!

rows.Speaker:
Guard
(Rui)
rows.Line: A thief is trying to break into the manor! Catch him at once!

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line: H-How did this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Gasp. No, it wasn't that funny... 
And certainly not worth a laugh from me...

rows.Speaker:
Little Girl
(Emu)
rows.Line: Oh! Are you Santa? I thought you were an old man, but you're really a girl!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Er... I'm sorry, you have the wrong idea...

rows.Speaker:
Little Girl
(Emu)
rows.Line: Huh? You're not Santa?

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line:
Well, I guess I am...!
Here, I brought you a present!

rows.Speaker:
Little Girl
(Emu)
rows.Line:
Yay! It's a teddy bear!
Thank you, Santa!

rows.Speaker:
Little Girl
(Emu)
rows.Line: I'm happy about the present, but I'm even happier that I finally got to see you!

rows.Speaker:
Little Girl
(Emu)
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Santa!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We're getting close to the finale.
I have to get the snow machine ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish I could make it snow over the audience too, but that wouldn't be feasible outdoors with the equipment we have.

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line:
Phew, all presents are delivered!
I couldn't have done it without your help!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Heh. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line:
Oh, the sun is starting to rise...
I'd better get back. Bye!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Wait... You could have stayed a little longer with me...

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line:
Everyone got their gifts... Except me.
Hmph...!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: But... Being thanked...

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: That might've been the best moment...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Gasp!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... The words are rolling off my tongue so naturally.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's as if a surge of feelings in my heart turned into this song and wants to be heard.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I completely forgot that singing can be this much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, time to make it snow...!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's actually snowing?)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...! It's like her song made it start snowing...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Like a little gift from the heavens...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is sooo awesome...!!
Rui, how on earth did you do this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's not me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe it's just a Christmas miracle.

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line: Heeey!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: It's you again? I thought you'd left...

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line:
Well, I had to make sure you got your gift too.
This is just for you! Do you like it?

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Well, it'll do nicely...

rows.Speaker:
Santa's Apprentice
(Tsukasa)
rows.Line:
I'll see you again next year!
Merry Christmas!

rows.Speaker:
Girl
(Nene)
rows.Line: Merry Christmas to you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... That was ten times harder than usual.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Kusanagi, I want a word with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, uh...
Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Your play was very good...
And your singing was outstanding.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, y-you think so? Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Your last song in particular was... It was so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Are you crying?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: N-No, of course not!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe she's not such a bad person after all.
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Guys! Mr. Mascot brought us an update on the standings!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally! Let me see!
Who's number one...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ph-Phoenix Stage is still number one?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, read it carefully. There's another set of rankings at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The one at the top is for cumulative scores and the one below is just for this last round.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp! You're right! And we came out on top for this round! We did it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did it!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, there could have been no other outcome! I knew we wouldn't lose to that fancy Phoenix Stage troupe!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're still behind them in overall score, but victory is within our reach. Everything hinges on the final round of shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I just wanted to say...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... All of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I remembered how to sing the way I used to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like I got my own Christmas present a little early...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Funny, but I feel that way too. Don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your smile, Nene! I've never seen you smile like this before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We all got our present early, so I guess that means today is Christmas for us this year♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! In that case, are you up for a Christmas party in SEKAI? We can tell Miku and her friends the good news too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! You're a genius, Tsukasa!
I'm gonna stuff my face full of cake!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to take a few stage props with us.
Can you help me carry the snow machine?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, you're going to make it snow in SEKAI? Miku and the others are in for a nice surprise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go, shall we?
